episode_definitions.flood_episode: A continuous episode where physical water depth is verified at d >= 5.0 cm on at least one travel lane, separated by at least 60 minutes or 500 meters from adjacent observations.
episode_definitions.non_flood_episode: A verified observation confirming asphalt is dry, damp, or puddle-only (d < 5.0 cm) under active or recent rainfall conditions, separated by at least 60 minutes.
episode_definitions.leakage_boundary: Observations from the same corridor and storm event date must reside in the same split partition.

gate_ruling: Supervised model evaluation is strictly prohibited. Current metrics reflect software rule conformance only, not real-world flood prediction accuracy.
